differences.what: Actual master reviewed: the adjacent garden opening is now a broad barred light at the independently read section bounds; the former flat shelf beyond the traced coping turn is removed.

T-2759: the terminal post is built where HABS sheet 2 draws it (circle fit to the plan's ring: centre W33.81/S46.20, radius 0.93 ft at the line's centre; built 0.9 ft) instead of T-2218's section-fitted S46.05 / 0.75 ft, which put the whole post inside the wall's end-on silhouette. It now stands about 0.6 ft proud of the wall's outer face, so in this view its shaft shows from grade to crown and the coping dies into its north side at about 4.45 ft, just above the crown's springing, as the section draws it. The three reconstructed lower tread ends are re-seated on the new surface. Evidence: docs/RESEARCH/glessner-terrace-terminal-T-2759/.

T-2879 ruled the plan against the section along S. Sheet 2's printed court chain (12'-6" + 12'-0" + 10'-0" + 12'-8" = 47'-2") governs, and the plan scan reproduces it: court face S26.99 for the printed 26.83, the bow's tangent on the east wing 39.42 for 39.33, the tower's south junction 61.27 for 61.33. Sheet 4 draws the same court shifted north, not rescaled: face 26.21, bow flank 38.66, so its bow is 12.45 ft across against the printed 12.5. Re-zeroed on the printed court face (+0.65 ft), its terminal post reads S46.0-47.3. The plan-built post, seen past the wall's end, shows S46.2-47.1, so the post agrees within 0.2 ft and stays where the plan puts it. The bow and the stair tower stay on the plan too (docs/RESEARCH/glessner-court-ruling-T-2879/). What this view still shows is the frame mix. The coping's traced profile and the two grilles were read at sheet 4's un-re-zeroed S, and the camera reads in that frame too. So the coping reaches the post 0.65 ft early, over a reconstructed shoulder, and in this view the brick wall end covers the post's north half (render S46.3) where the drawing shows the stone shaft from S45.4. T-2880 carries those readings and this camera onto the plan's frame.
Local grille surround/trim and exact terminal/court-ground correspondence remain different. No camera translation or source-pick revision has concealed these residuals.
Iron/frame stock and masonry color/weathering remain bounded reconstructions.
